ios.desc:
Weather.exe brings the charm of Windows 95 to your iPhone's weather forecast.

Check the temperature, hourly outlook, 10-day forecast, wind, humidity, pressure, and more - all inside a lovingly crafted retro desktop interface, complete with title bars, beveled panels, a Start button, and that unmistakable silver-gray aesthetic.

Now with widgets! Pin Weather.exe right to your Home Screen or Lock Screen, in small, medium, or large sizes - all rendered in the same authentic Win95 style, right down to the beveled window chrome.

FEATURES
- Windows 95 UI
- Home & Lock Screen widgets
- Current conditions, hourly & 10-day forecast
- Wind, humidity, pressure, visibility & more
- Add and switch between multiple locations
- Global weather coverage via Open-Meteo
- Imperial and metric units supported

Whether you grew up with Windows 95 or just appreciate the aesthetic, Weather.exe is the most nostalgic way to check if you need an umbrella.

Boot it up.
